# OCR for flier pictures (v109.59)

tesseract.js 7.0.0, tesseract.js-core 6.1.2 (LSTM builds only) and the English model
(@tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int). Apache-2.0. Loaded only when HQ or a host
uploads a flier picture: the browser reads the words on it, so they can be translated and
painted in each language. Nothing is sent to a third party.
